updatePolicy: Manually pin a specific OllamaSetup.exe release; bump version + re-hash sha256 each time.
packagingPath: Downloaded at runtime to the OS temp dir; never bundled in the installer.
rollback: Uninstall via Ollama's own uninstaller; Jenny never auto-uninstalls Ollama.
_comment: PROVENANCE MANIFEST (per docs/BUILDING.md § Release Provenance and Evidence). Pinned to Ollama v0.30.10 (2026-06-24). To update: download the new OllamaSetup.exe, run `(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 .\OllamaSetup.exe).Hash`, and update url/version/sizeBytes/sha256. If sha256 is ever left empty, getInstallPlan() reports available:false and installOllama() refuses to download (fail-closed).
